notes.title: Gameplay, numerical, functional updates, bug fixes
notes.content:
1. Added achievement system.  
2. Optimized the numerical balance, including player health, enemy health, item dodge probability, medical pack health, etc., to make the completion easier, increase the level of interest, reduce the difficulty.  
3. Enemy AI tweaked a little.  
4. Fixed UI display related bugs.  
 
Have a good time!
